objective: Modern, fast, compact and intuitive BUKLOD with production-mirrored staging first; no regressions or missing mandatory UX features.
policy: A status is VERIFIED only after evidence. In-progress code does not count as release-ready. Staging parity requires independent live/installed artifact proof; production and web are prohibited until approval. Source-implemented means source/test integration only; complete staging and physical acceptance require independent evidence, never synthetic CI.

requirements.title: Verified live/staging source, native identity and installed OTA parity
Canonical route/feature inventory including disabled and role-restricted paths
Fail-closed completion and staging identity release guard
Permanent non-hideable Settings gear and grouped settings
Offline task-oriented feature finder with simple Filipino/English synonyms
Replace excessive Home card/padding weight without hiding essential actions
Simplify Profile quick actions and redundant feature doors
Canonical Home/Drawer/Focus Apps/Community labels and explanations
Contextual overflow menus and optional bottom sheets
Long-press and swipe shortcuts with visible accessible alternatives
Low-cost, reduced-motion-aware navigation and card transitions
OS-scaled readable inputs across all key forms and composers
Native keyboard GIF direct-to-current-composer with safe fallback and preview
Correct Back, deep links, scroll, scope, draft and media state restoration
Nonblocking success/error/retry and safe undo feedback
Offline/cached navigation, draft recovery, empty/loading/error states
Privacy-safe favorites/recent activities, safe Continue destinations
Dismissible contextual hints and separate searchable Help
Role-aware workspace identity, TalkBack, contrast, font and tap QA
Functional, security, ads, media, Connect and performance regression suite
Signed exact-source staging APK/OTA and verified installed behavior
